messages:
ryan_sales: Prospect (MapleBank) asks about BYOK POC: split custody (us-east + eu-west), imported EC keys, automated rotation at 12h, and per-1M op pricing. They want attestation on each rotate.

jules_sre: Clarify workload: mostly ES256 signing? what's peak QPS?

ryan_sales: Yes ES256 signing, peak ~900 QPS, steady 200. POC 48h with a planned failover test at 30h.

ana_security: We support import of EC keys via secure flow, provide FIPS 140-2 L3 attestation bundles per rotate. Wrapped-only escrow under customer KEK by default. If they require Redwood-held escrow plaintext, legal addendum needed.

jules_sre: Presales (non-binding): one-time import $950/key, ECDSA sign ops $26 per 1M, cross-region surcharge $15 per 1M. Note: 12h rotates OK for POC but recommend 24h for production unless they accept extra monitoring.

paul_custrep: I'll ask customer for org contact for key ceremony, legal escrow decision, and whether third-party custodian needed. Also confirm acceptance of wrapped-only escrow.

notify-bot: Ticket created: REDWOOD-POC-3120 - "MapleBank BYOK split-custody POC" - assignees: @ryan_sales @jules_sre @ana_security

ryan_sales: Next steps: paul to collect contacts + escrow choice, jules to send perf caveats + SRE checklist, ana to draft SQ answers and sample attestation bundle. I'll compile and send to customer by EOD. :thumbsup:
